newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Samsung to supply mobile phones to Hutch.
newsitem.headline: Samsung to supply mobile phones to Hutch.

text.p: Samsung Electronic Co Ltd said on Monday it had reached an agreement with Hutchison Telecommunications Ltd to supply 20,000 units of CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access) mobile phones to the Hong Kong firm.
A second contract for an additional 20,000 units is under negotiation and will be signed by the end of the year.
The two deals together are valued at US$20 million, Samsung said in a statement.
The first shipment is scheduled to take place in the first quarter of 1997.
Hutchison Telecommunications is a unit of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd.
